story_understanding.central_truth: The study links speech judgements more strongly to rapid temporal changes and music judgements to fine spectral detail, while cautioning that these cues are not necessarily the brain's only mechanisms.
story_understanding.viewer_question: How can listeners separate speech from music when both overlap?
emotional_arc: Curiosity about an everyday listening mystery
A clear reveal that time and frequency provide different acoustic clues
A satisfying original violin phrase that makes those dimensions audible
key_revelations: Speech judgements relied mainly on rapid changes in sound over time.
Music judgements relied mainly on detailed patterns across sound frequencies.
The research combined implanted-electrode recordings from eleven epilepsy patients with listening responses from nineteen other adults.

production_binding.title: E-Mortal Boy: Rema's Seven-Track Genre Map
production_binding.topic: A concise arrangement story about Rema's E-Mortal Boy: its seven-track format, varied genre influences, two earlier singles, five new records and guest features.
production_binding.narration_script: Can Rema's new EP surprise global listeners? Premium Times describes seven tracks across several musical genres. WeTalkSound says five new records join two previously released singles. Wizkid, BNYX, Theodora, and Kah-Lo all feature as guests.

story_understanding.central_truth: E-Mortal Boy is a compact seven-track EP that moves across several genres, brings two prior singles together with five new records, and includes four guest artists named by the reviewed publishers.
story_understanding.viewer_question: How can one short EP move through so many musical directions?
emotional_arc: A seven-track release opens as a compact musical world
Genre and release structure reveal its range without assuming every experiment succeeds
An original violin phrase turns that range into a coherent musical payoff
key_revelations: Premium Times describes the EP as seven tracks and roughly twenty-two minutes, with dancehall, rumba, R&B, electronic, grunge and house influences.
WeTalkSound reports two earlier singles and five new records.
WeTalkSound lists Wizkid, BNYX, Theodora and Kah-Lo among the guest appearances.

visual_concept.visual_metaphor: Seven floating music rooms orbit a central release timeline, each room carrying a different rhythmic material before the pieces resolve into one original violin phrase.
visual_concept.creative_rationale: The EP is short but stylistically varied; the rooms make its range visible while the timeline anchors the verifiable two-plus-five release structure.
visual_concept.art_direction: Contemporary music-culture documentary: rich layered colour, editorial track markers, tactile paper and stage-light materials, and rhythmic transitions without artist likeness or album/game artwork.

palette.reasoning: Violet, teal and amber form a lively triadic relationship suited to contrasting musical textures while remaining clearly separated.
palette.contrast_strategy: Use warm ivory typography over the violet field, reserve teal and amber for separate track groups, and keep all seven markers individually readable on mobile.

visual_concept.lighting_plan: Purple-blue ambient base with teal side light on the track map and warm amber highlights for the new-record and final-motif reveals.
visual_concept.composition_language: Present the seven-part structure in a clear central arc; place guest names as restrained typography and hold the lower-right safe zone open for the presenter.

edit_direction.pacing: A 32-second vertical documentary arc: hook, evidence, explanation and original musical payoff. Vary shot duration and composition; never hold a still frame as a substitute for motion.
edit_direction.transition_language: Use the directed sequence of hard cut, match cut, whip pan, dissolve, luma wipe, light transition and shape match; each transition follows a change in the story rather than a fixed template.
edit_direction.typography: Use short high-contrast mobile-safe labels, no more than one key idea at a time; maintain safe margins and keep the presenter's face and hands clear.
edit_direction.sound_design: Use original transition accents and light percussive detail. Keep narration intelligible and duck the music under speech. Do not add movie, game, artist or product audio.
edit_direction.music_mood: Playful and rhythmically varied, with an original violin phrase that moves through contrasting textures without borrowing the EP's melodies.
